mapper.select: SELECT id, device_code AS deviceCode, device_name AS deviceName, device_type AS deviceType, ip_address AS ipAddress, port, protocol, status, description, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM device ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, device_code AS deviceCode, device_name AS deviceName, device_type AS deviceType, ip_address AS ipAddress, port, protocol, status, description, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM device WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device ( device_code, device_name, device_type, ip_address, port, protocol, status, description ) VALUES ( #{deviceCode}, #{deviceName}, #{deviceType}, #{ipAddress}, #{port}, #{protocol}, #{status}, #{description} )
mapper.update: UPDATE device SET device_name = #{deviceName}, device_type = #{deviceType}, ip_address = #{ipAddress}, port = #{port}, protocol = #{protocol}, status = #{status}, description = #{description} WHERE id = #{id}
